verdict.rationale: Marqeta's MCP Server explicitly enables AI agents to interact with the platform using natural language (card issuance, spend controls, transaction intelligence queries), but this is scoped to a designated set of read/query and limited write endpoints rather than full natural-language operation of the entire API surface, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: evidence of full-platform NL coverage beyond the documented subset, independent user validation, and confirmation of NL support outside the MCP server context.
